crossRefs.note: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.
He touched her hand, and the fever left her. She got up and served him.
He rose up from the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever…
He stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.
Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay…

people.name: James
people.line: Son of Zebedee, one of the Twelve Apostles

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
translations.bsb: As soon as Jesus and His companions had left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
translations.kjv: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
translations.asv: And straightway, when they were come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
